label_support.n_scored: count of bundle rows whose counter_status is in scored_statuses
label_support.n_supported: count of scored rows whose frozen-rubric primary class is SUPPORTED (criteria i-v all pass under the vendored primary variant)
label_support.support_rate: n_supported / n_scored when n_scored > 0 else null (published as 0/0/0.0 when n_scored==0)
label_support.abstention_count: count of bundle rows whose counter_status is 'none' (the abstain-and-disclose classifier config issues no label) plus count of rows with status 'abstained_unevidenced' if present
label_support.yield_over_population: n_scored / n_decisions (share of the row population that received an issued counter label)
label_support.absolute_bar_as_written: LABEL_SOUND iff n_scored > 0 AND n_supported == n_scored (support_rate == 1.0); LABEL_UNSOUND otherwise. REPORTED, never enforced as a build blocker.
label_support.regression_predicate_as_written: lineage := (set(per_bundle qids) == {de-kapitalverletzung, fr-bail-entretien, it-responsabilita-medica}) AND (n_scored == 65); FAIL_REGRESSION := lineage AND n_supported < 5; PASS_NO_REGRESSION := lineage AND NOT FAIL; NOT_APPLICABLE := NOT lineage. NOT_APPLICABLE is an inapplicability marker, NOT a pass.
label_support.label_lineage_gate_verdict: the accepted population-free label_lineage_gate instrument's verdict at this scored population, published BESIDE the population-pinned regression verdict; a build-blocking FAIL_REGRESSION at n_scored==0 is NOT a pass and NOT_APPLICABLE is never counted as a pass

geometry.per_criterion_bars: read AS WRITTEN from RULES_GEOMETRY.json criteria.*.bar at scoring time; never re-derived, re-tuned or edited
geometry.bundle_pass: PASS iff ALL 11 criteria pass on that bundle; any FAIL => bundle FAIL
geometry.absolute_bar: GEOMETRY_SOUND iff every bundle passes all 11 criteria; otherwise GEOMETRY_UNSOUND. REPORTED, never enforced as a build blocker.
geometry.regression_predicate_as_written: lineage := (set(per_bundle qids) == the three incumbent qids) [no population pin]; regressed_qids := [qid where lineage AND n_pass < incumbent_count(qid)] with incumbent de 6 / fr 5 / it 5; FAIL_REGRESSION := lineage AND regressed_qids non-empty; PASS_NO_REGRESSION := lineage AND empty; NOT_APPLICABLE := NOT lineage
geometry.shipped_vs_recompute: primary verdict metrics read SHIPPED bundle x/y/cluster/label fields (the gate renders these); recompute_vs_shipped agreement reported as sanity only, never a pass criterion

mega_cluster_disclosure.definition: the size-based map_is_one_mega_cluster disclosure fires on a bundle when the largest-cluster share (largest_cluster_size / n_decisions, SHIPPED assignment) >= 0.50
mega_cluster_disclosure.note: mapping-free disclosure conformance, NOT a frozen-bar verdict; reported per bundle

marginal_discovery.K_basis: the conventional top-20 named in the frozen RULES_LABEL reporting block ('count of SUPPORTED rows outside the conventional top-20'); frozen here before execution
marginal_discovery.issued_counter_row: a bundle row whose counter_status is in scored_statuses (the map's discoverable counter/contrary authorities are exactly the issued counter rows)
marginal_discovery.absent_from_initial_pool_topK: the issued counter row's decision_id is not among the K rows with the best (lowest) retrieval rank in the SAME bundle
marginal_discovery.least_ranked_list_position: the row's 1-based position in the ranked list sorted by retrieval rank ascending (its worst-case visibility in a conventional list scan)
marginal_discovery.counter_only_in_map_invisible_in_list: the row is an issued counter authority (discoverable via the map) AND its least-ranked list position > K (effectively invisible in the top of a conventional ranked list)
marginal_discovery.marginal_discovery_set: the set of issued counter rows that are absent_from_initial_pool_topK (equivalently, whose least-ranked position > K). Empty set => the map adds no marginal discovery on this packet.
marginal_discovery.note: measured on the SAME already-loaded bundles for both views; no second retrieval

verdict_thresholds.SERVE: the packet-of-record v3 passes BOTH frozen absolute bars as written on its own bytes (LABEL_SOUND: support_rate == 1.0 with n_scored > 0; GEOMETRY_SOUND: all 11 criteria on all 3 bundles) AND the size-based mega-cluster disclosure fires where share >= 0.5 AND the serve recommendation explicitly replaces the DO-NOT-SERVE verdict. NOTHING ELSE IS A SERVE PATH: n_scored=0 is not a 1.0 and not a pass; a QUERY_MAP_MVP section 7 minimum-semantics assessment may be REPORTED but never used as a serve criterion.
verdict_thresholds.DO-NOT-SERVE-UNCHANGED: the bars remain unmet as written and the serve conclusion is unchanged; the standing accepted DO-NOT-SERVE orders stand; owner_decision_required=FALSE
verdict_thresholds.BOUNDED-NEGATIVE: both frozen absolute bars remain unmet and no in-budget fix exists; at most ONE bounded cause per failed half; converts the map-versus-ranked-list choice into ONE explicit owner product decision ONLY IF its own record carries owner_decision_required=true; otherwise a recorded bounded negative the director routes
decision_tree: IF label_absolute == LABEL_SOUND AND geometry_absolute == GEOMETRY_SOUND AND mega_cluster_disclosure_fires_where_share_ge_0.5 THEN SERVE
ELSE IF label_absolute == LABEL_UNSOUND AND geometry_absolute == GEOMETRY_UNSOUND AND marginal_discovery_set_is_empty THEN BOUNDED-NEGATIVE
ELSE IF label_absolute == LABEL_UNSOUND AND geometry_absolute == GEOMETRY_UNSOUND THEN DO-NOT-SERVE-UNCHANGED
ELSE the halves disagree: report both numbers side by side and promote the improving half AS SUCH, never explained away by the pre-packet baseline
verdict_thresholds.owner_session_guard: NO owner card, NO owner session, NO ready_for_owner_session=true, NO human_gate_ready=true is produced, staged or readied from ANY outcome of this charter. human_gate_ready is never touched.

non_vacuity.seeded_control: permute cluster_id assignment across rows (seed 0) and permute label texts across cluster ids; recompute all 11 criteria; corrupted geometry must flip >= 2 criteria verdicts
non_vacuity.negative_control: the harness must be able to output BOTH a SERVE and a DO-NOT-SERVE outcome under seeded control inputs (proven reachable, not asserted)
non_vacuity.label_injection: the frozen injection battery from RULES_LABEL.non_vacuity (8 rows, 5 defect classes) must be assigned its frozen expected_class, exercising >= 2 distinct defect criteria; injected rows are excluded from the population support rate and the verdict

claim_ceiling: This team independently recomputes the frozen label and geometry scoring on the packet-of-record v3 bytes as a CROSS-CHECK of Core Evaluation's published numbers, measures marginal discovery on the same bytes, and emits ONE serve recommendation. It re-derives no threshold, bar, rubric or verdict contract. It never asserts that any case IS supporting/contrary/limiting without evidence. It writes no product file and touches no gate flag.
